thread:
maya: kicking off US->EU->APAC rollout for service inference-api v1.14.0. change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Plan: US canary (5%) -> US ramp (25%) -> EU canary (5%) -> EU ramp -> APAC hold until backfill. @ops_liz can you confirm warm pool + spare quota? release notes: https://redwood.in/release/v1.14.0 :rocket:

ops_liz: warm pool at ~78% warming, expected 90% in ~12m. APAC spare GPUs are low (only ~10% spare right now). Will try to add more but may be best-effort.

oliver: recommend pinning enterprise customers to v1.13.9 for first 24h. Also suggest we enable model-variant fallback for LLM-small if v1.14.0 shows perf regressions.

jin: ran a 15m smoke on staging with ~10k tokens/min — tail latencies look stable. headroom estimates: US 2.6x, EU 1.8x, APAC 1.1x. attached log: `staging-smoke-2301.log`

sami: proposing rollback triggers: error rate >0.8% sustained for 3m OR p95 latency >500ms for 5m. Add soft hold on p50 >300ms for 10m to pause ramp.

maya: agree. will set deploy-bot rollback_config accordingly. @deploy-bot prepare canary slice and pin rollout policy (enterprise pin on failure).

deploy-bot: deployment queued by maya. Command:
```
deploy start --service inference-api --image v1.14.0 --regions us,eu --canary 5 --ramp 25 --pin-on-failure previous:v1.13.9
```
ETA canary start 02:05 UTC. Monitoring hooks: latency, errors, cost, fallback rate.

neil: APAC stays at 0% until EU stable + extra capacity added. If EU shows any capacity eviction events or OOMs, stop roll immediately and pin back.

eva: adding a temporary throttle: reduce batch_size to 8 and disable kv-prefetch for the first 10k requests in canary to avoid sudden memory spikes. Will toggle back after verification.

ops_liz: added 10 GPUs to APAC warm pool by 02:30 UTC (best effort). Will post update when instances finish warming.

maya: starting canary in US at 02:05. Everyone watch #eng-oncall and this thread. If you see regression ping me directly. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: canary started in us at 02:05 UTC (slice id s-4821). Monitoring URL: https://console.redwood/inference/dash/s-4821. Alerts wired to oncall and rollbacks set.

maya: quick checklist for folks: 1) watch latency and error percent, 2) watch eviction/oom signals in eu nodes, 3) confirm APAC warm pool post. We'll wait 15m after canary stable before ramping US to 25% and then kick EU canary. If anything looks off we revert to previous:v1.13.9 and escalate.
